_comment: The live-walk steps the harness must clear (Brian, 2026-09-19, report items 6 and 11). A spec clears a step by pushing an annotation { type: 'walk-step', description: '<path>:<step>|<control>|<roles>|<tap|api|fixture>' } while it runs; scripts/walk-evidence.mjs joins this manifest with apps/e2e/.artifacts/last-run.json. A step with no passing annotation is not cleared.

steps.text: Add the business with its EIN, make it primary
Business-tax quote against it, $0 deposit override with a reason, send
Accept the quote, sign Schedule B, business onboarding form, upload a document
Engagement packet created and sent for signature
Section 7216 consent answered
Lock the estimate, walk the stages to internal review, deliver the return PDF to the portal
My Returns shows it
Upload the signed 8879-CORP scan with its signed date and the PTIN holder
Set the final fee, ready to file, filed with the PTIN holder
Upload the ATX ack report, review the rows, release
Both rows read Sent; two acceptance emails
Pay the final-fee invoice
Receipt, the money line, the completed engagement

B.title: The 1040 on extension, walk-in wet-sign (Path B)

steps.text: Contact created
Quote built and sent
Accepted with the deposit paid
Engagement packet assembled and sent
Section 7216 consent answered
Onboarding questionnaire submitted
Documents uploaded by the client
Return delivered to the portal
Signed 8879 scan uploaded, wet-signed in office
Filed with the PTIN holder
Acknowledgment report uploaded and released
Acceptance emails sent
Final invoice issued
Paid
Engagement completed

D.title: Doors: void, test-client flag and refund

steps.text: Void a sent invoice from the client page: a reason, and the row reads cancelled with that reason and the actor
Flag a contact as a test record: the note, and the record leaves every report and list
Refund a paid invoice from Ops
With the Refund control off: the paid row reads that refunds are made in Stripe and recorded here, no Refund button, and the route refuses

E.title: The emailed link opens what it names; the migrated client's two addresses

steps.text: A proposal link renders its quote for the recipient with a lapsed session and the browser's stale signed-in marker; no redirect to the sign-in request page
A sign-in link is spent by the button on its page, never by the load

The client page warns when the portal sign-in address is not the contact email and offers one control to make them the same; refused in the server's words when another account holds it; the bookkeeper has no control
Documents lists a signed agreement copy, a delivered return and a client upload made through the page's own control, with no console error
A page that fails to render shows one plain sentence and a Reload control, the firm gets a task and an Ops alert naming the route, and Reload shows the page again

Q.title: The Quotes card on the client page

steps.text: Open a quote from the card: the Ops quote page reads the client, the business, the lines and the state
Copy the client link: a fresh portal link, the confirmation line, and the link opens the proposal
Resend the proposal email: the same send path, a new link in the mailer, the confirmation line
Withdraw a draft with a reason: the row reads Withdrawn

M.title: MFA recovery codes and Reset MFA (R65)

steps.text: Enrolment shows eight recovery codes once and waits for 'I saved these'
A recovery code signs in once and is consumed; the same code is refused; the CEO gets the alert task
The CEO presses Reset MFA with a reason on the staff row; the member's next sign-in lands on enrolment
Role proof: comms_billing sees no Reset MFA control and the route refuses 403

Each staff mail (temporary password issued, recovery code used, MFA reset) links to the Ops sign-in page; the link opened from the mailbox signs the member in; the notice never carries the password (R71)

P.title: The contact email and the sign-in, the portal after signing, the upload control, Deliver Return, My Returns (R45 to R48)

steps.text: Changing the contact email offers to move the sign-in; one confirmation link to the new address; pending on the client page with Resend; the link's button moves it, a bare load does not
The portal home after signing: no 'Waiting for your signature' for the signed document, no withdrawn engagement's documents, no duplicate rows; the sign page reads 'Signed on'
The upload control: no capture attribute, several files at once, the category starts unselected and is required, the empty card has text
Deliver Return's confirmation states what happened: not emailed because the notice is switched off; emailed when it is armed
My Returns 'What happens next' reads the return's state: 8879 not yet sent, sent by Adobe Sign, on file, filed

F.title: Filed on, and the filing corrected (Path F)

steps.text: Mark filed takes Filed on: opens on today, a day after today refused, a day before the signed 8879 refused, today files
Correct the filing: remove a jurisdiction with a reason; the line leaves the row and the history line reads the correction; the bookkeeper has no control and the route refuses her
Correct the filing: change the PTIN holder; the offer to move the assigned preparer opens checked and both move
Correct the filing: the 8879 signed date moved earlier to the day on the paper; a day after today refused in the modal; the history line reads the correction (R69)
Correct the filing: the 8879 scan replaced; the previous document row reads superseded, stays listed and downloadable; the return points at the new scan (R69)

Correct the filing: move the filed date earlier; a day before the CORRECTED signed 8879 refused in the modal naming that day, the corrected signed day lands (the rule reads the corrected value, inclusive)

N.title: The Form 990 on extension, 8879-TE (Path B, 990 variant, R66)

steps.text: The exempt organization's 990 at ready to file (fixture); Record extension opens on Form 8868 and the row reads the derived extended deadline
Upload the signed 8879: the Form select opens on 8879-TE; the row reads "8879-TE on file, signed <date>"
Mark filed: federal alone (IL removed in the modal), e-filed, with the PTIN holder
The ATX export with the organization's 990 Federal Accepted row: uploaded, matched on the EIN, released; the return completes and the engagement closes
The CEO's "Reopen…" on a completed row: a standalone reason; the row reads filed and Reopened
The engagement is active again and the executive view counts the return as open
Re-completion refused until a new acceptance is recorded; the new acceptance completes it; the preparer has no control and the route refuses 403

H.title: The business in every Ops search, the stage row that opens, the duplicate EIN (R51, R52, R54)

steps.text: Deliver Return: the search matches the business legal name and the match reads "Business — owner"
New quote: the client search matches the business legal name and the chip reads "Business — owner"
The clients list: the search matches the business legal name and the row reads "Business — owner"
An "Open returns by stage" row on the executive view opens the list for that stage: client, business, form, preparer, days in stage
Add a business with an EIN another business holds: the warning links to that business and its owner, "Create anyway" takes a reason; Edit follows the same rule

S.title: The Returns card as a stepper (R50), behind OPS_RETURN_STEPPER

steps.text: With the switch on, the rail shows five phases (Engage, Prepare, Sign, File, Close); only the current phase is open, its current step carries the one control and one sentence and its other steps are one line each; a done phase is one line with its date, a future phase its greyed name
The details area carries the secondary actions (change preparer, record extension, correct the filing at filed); ed_coo reads the phases with no control and no details area
With the switch off the row renders as production runs it, and GET /auth/me reports the state

T.title: The preparer's day: home, navigation, a return end to end, the cards (R64)

steps.text: Signed in as the tax preparer, / lands on My Queue, never on the Executive view; nothing is left loading
The top navigation shows only her pages; the count and names equal the tax_preparer row of the nav-items-by-role record

From the queue's Client packet, the assigned return worked end to end: lock estimate, the stages to internal review, deliver, record 8879 sent, upload the signed 8879, final fee, ready to file, filed with Filed on, the acknowledgment uploaded and released
The client page's cards: Invoices and the next session read "Not available to your role" with no count; every card she can read renders

From the client page's Businesses card the business name opens /businesses/:id: the entity, the owner linked back, the seven cards in the proposal's order; Edit business saves and the entity card reads it back
From search: the clients-list "Business — owner" row opens the business page

Role proof: the bookkeeper reads entity, owners, service facts and documents; Engagements, Returns and Invoices read "Not available to your role" with no count; the EIN is the last four only; no Edit business
With the switch off the route prints "This page is not switched on.", the Businesses card name is plain text, and the clients-list row opens the client

L.title: The billing hold on an imported engagement (R68)

steps.text: The client page's engagement row reads "Billing on hold (imported)" with the importer's reason, the status sentence says it, and the CEO has "Lift billing hold…"
The CEO lifts the hold with a reason: a chat-artifact reason is refused under the field in the server's words; the real one lands; the badge leaves the re-read row
Role proof: ed_coo reads the badge with no control; comms_billing has no control and the route refuses 403 engagements.billing_hold.lift
